name: Akedia
source:
Highly knowledgeable in the magic arts, he can use a large array of spells. [spoiler]His body is comprised of two heads, one that belongs to himself while the other belongs to his sister, [url=/c3155]Scholastica[/url].
Being apostles of Index and subordinates of [url=https://vndb.org/c3156]Georgius of the Rainbow[/url], he and his sister fought with the other members of the Punishment Squad against Liselotte in the past; and although they died, they were revived afterwards by [url=https://vndb.org/c3152]Misao[/url] using a single body for both of them.
Their Index names are "Benedictus of the Bookshelf" and "Scholastica of the Bookshelf".[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://11eyes.fandom.com/wiki/Acedia]11eyes wiki[/url]]
